spec.description: SIPI IIIF media server: latency, throughput, caching, decode-memory and pool saturation, rate limiting, errors, and the dsp-api /admin/files permission route SIPI calls on every request. Switchable across environments.

options.content: IIIF / media-server health for the **$environment** environment. Leading indicators of degraded image serving: **p95/p99 latency**, **cache hit ratio**, and **pool load-shedding**. Every IIIF request also triggers a permission check against dsp-api at `/admin/files/{projectShortcode}/{filename}` — see the **dsp-api auth route** row.

spec.title: Environment
spec.description: Canonical VRE host for the selected environment.

spec.title: Auth route request rate by status (/admin/files)
spec.description: dsp-api permission check SIPI calls on every IIIF request. 4xx = auth denials, 5xx = errors.

spec.title: Auth route avg latency (/admin/files)
spec.description: Average latency of the dsp-api permission check (rate of sum / rate of count). No histogram buckets are exported for this route, so percentiles are unavailable.

spec.title: Decode Memory Admission (rate)
spec.description: Admission-control decisions on the decode-memory budget.

spec.title: Decode Memory Estimate (p95)
spec.description: p95 of per-request estimated decode memory.

spec.title: Worker Pool Permits (in use vs total)
Pool Load-Shed & Queue Timeout (rate)
spec.description: Overload signals: requests shed or timed out waiting for a worker.

spec.title: Errors & Integrity (rate)
spec.description: Image-too-large rejections, essentials hash mismatches, memory allocation failures, and client disconnects.

spec.title: Host CPU Utilisation
spec.description: Node-level CPU for the hosts running SIPI in the selected environment. Node metrics carry no environment label, so hosts are selected by joining on sipi_build_info.

spec.title: Host Memory Available
spec.description: Node-level available memory as % of total, for the hosts running SIPI in the selected environment (joined on sipi_build_info).
